status: Qualified enabled cave minimum and native rendering of the saved 500 m planet at 1 and 100

contract.enabled: Every enabled knob position, including 0 and 1, produces at least one admissible generated cave network. The eye toggle is the way to request zero.
contract.density: Existing physical-density draws run first. If they already produce networks, counts and candidate identities are unchanged. Otherwise use the first complete admissible candidate in deterministic draw order. Zero advanced density leaves the enabled minimum.
contract.incompatibleGeology: Refuse compilation with an explicit error rather than accept an empty cave result. Do not fabricate unsupported hosts/provinces or a preview-only cave.
contract.format: Recipe schema 23 and native operation format unchanged; this implements the explicitly requested correction to the existing enabled-layer contract. Saved asset bytes are preserved.
contract.presentation: All native cave surfaces together through the dimmed planet; unchanged camera, selection and ordinary navigation.

diagnosis.cause: Sparse physical occurrence produced zero networks on the small body; there was nothing for the native diagnostic to render.
diagnosis.nativeResolutionCorrection: Fixed display-space voxels over-refine small normalized bodies and under-resolve narrow profiles. Derive target physical cell size as min(20 cm, half of the narrowest passage half-width), convert through the existing display scale to VPP integer voxel size, floor to retain detail, and respect its 1 cm display minimum.

ownership.specialization: An authoring minimum in the existing geological placement compiler; complete existing host/province/path checks and the same native cutter path. No alternate cave generator or debug-only geometry.
ownership.native: VPP owns shape/blend/AABB kernels, voxel sampling, subdivision/LOD, meshing, material binding and presentation. The existing static per-network native diagnostic domains are reused.
